tools.name: weight_loss_timeline
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how long it takes to lose a set amount of weight, such as "how long to lose 10 kg", "85 to 75 kg how many weeks" or "how fast can I lose 5 kg with a 500 calorie deficit".
